properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated December 4, 1933; includes description of passengers injured in the accident at Zhoushan Island [aircraft registration number NC16V] and opinions about Pan American Airways’ operation in China so far; mentions George Hamill, Bill [William] Grooch. Missing back of last page
